name: configuration-platform
description: Multi-tenant Configuration Management SaaS — monorepo (backend, portal frontend, public site renderer).

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix site-renderer
scripts.build:all: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:renderer
scripts.lint:all: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.test:all: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:renderer
